subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 60-90m technical readout and agenda alignment
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.inference.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@quantifoil.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 1 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 60-90m technical readout and agenda alignment

Hi Evan — great convo earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Goal for next session: 60–90 minute technical readout focused on production readiness (latency & throughput targets, model variants, data residency & retention, and integration points).
- Attendees we typically bring: one solutions engineer (Ben) + an engagement lead (Marissa) + myself. Would also like your lead infra/ML engineer and the person owning data retention controls on the call.

Availability from our side (PT):
- Tue May 10: 9:00–11:30 or 14:00–16:00
- Thu May 12: 10:00–12:00 (pref) or 15:00–16:30

Can you confirm 1–2 slots that work for your team and who will join from Quantifoil? Also attaching a short discovery notes PDF and a proposed agenda draft — feel free to edit the agenda doc link.

High-level proposed agenda (editable):
1) 5–10m intros and goals
2) 20–30m production architecture & current bottlenecks
3) 20–30m model serving perf targets and cost envelope
4) 15–20m integration surface & security/compliance (SOC2, data residency)
5) 10–15m runbook/fallbacks and Q&A

If the team expects to cover large-scale benchmarking or bring live logs, we can make the session 90 minutes. Otherwise 60 is fine. 

Thanks — Sergio

Attachments: discovery-notes-quantifoil.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)
Agenda link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/quantifoil-tdx-agenda
From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@quantifoil.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 1 May 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: scheduling 60-90m technical readout and agenda alignment

Thanks, Sergio — this looks good. Appreciate the recap. A few notes from our side before locking a slot: 

- We definitely want the 90-minute option; our infra lead needs time to walk through current latency spikes under burst traffic.
- Important topics: data retention policy (we have GDPR EU users; need to understand VPC/on‑prem options and KMS integration), and fallback behavior if Redwood Dedicated capacity is temporarily unavailable.
- Attendees: myself (CTO), Priya Narang (Head of ML Ops), and Raj Patel (Lead Backend Engineer). Priya and Raj are available next week on Thu May 12 10:00–11:30 PT — that works best for us.

Can Ben bring any short benchmarking examples (throughput numbers on p3 vs. a40, KV-cache sizing tips)? Also please include any pre-read you want Priya to look at for compliance items.

Best,
Evan
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@quantifoil.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 2 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: scheduling 60-90m technical readout and agenda alignment

Nice to meet you over email, Evan — Ben here (solutions engineering). Confirming we can make Thu May 12 10:00–11:30 PT (90m). I'll bring: 

- 15m of recent benchmarking slides: steady-state tokens/sec numbers and burst behavior across A40 and p3 configurations; KV-cache sizing heuristics.
- A short checklist for preflight (required env variables, expected network egress, and sample Docker image).
- A one‑page runbook template we can iterate during the call.

I've attached a proposed agenda file and dropped a tentative calendar event (accept the invite if the time works). Marissa — looping you for commercial/contracting Qs and to own outcome tracking.

Attachments: proposed-tdx-agenda.md (Markdown, editable)
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=quantifoil-tdx-may12
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.inference.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@quantifoil.ai>, Priya Narang <priya.narang@quantifoil.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 2 May 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Technical readout Thu May 12 10:00–11:30 PT (Zoom invite)

Great — locked for Thu May 12 10:00–11:30 PT (90 minutes). Zoom link and calendar invite attached — please accept when convenient. Agenda updated to reflect compliance and fallback discussion early in the session so Priya gets time for SOC2/residency questions.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=quantifoil
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=quantifoil-tdx-may12

Pre-reads attached: discovery-notes-quantifoil.pdf, proposed-tdx-agenda.md. If Priya can share any compliance checklist items ahead of the call that would help us prepare.

See you all then — Sergio
